blocking_features.quote: If you use an errorAndLog validation action on a collection, MongoDB cannot downgrade until you drop the collection, or if you change the validation action for the collection to one supported in older versions.

8.3.lands_on: latest patch of the target series
8.3.quote: Starting with MongoDB 8.3, the setFeatureCompatibilityVersion supports downgrading the FCV (Feature Compatibility Version) to the previous minor version.
8.3.quote2: If you need to downgrade from 8.3, downgrade to the latest patch release of 8.0.

blocking_features.quote: If you need to downgrade the FCV to anything below 8.3, you must first drop the 2dsphere version 4 indexes.
you must update or remove the view or rule before downgrading from MongoDB 8.3 to an earlier version.
If you need to downgrade from 8.3, you must first update or drop any views that depend on expressions not supported in the target version.
If you attempt to downgrade while validated collections exist, the downgrade fails.
If you downgrade to a version that doesn't support the larger capacity, the limit reverts to 16 MB and MongoDB can lose some representative queries.

8.3.note: Only one step: a deployment downgraded 8.3 to 8.2 cannot then go 8.2 to 8.0 (single-version downgrades only).

8.3.quote: Make a full backup of your data and configuration files
8.3.note: Percona's 8.3 docs have no downgrade page (sitemap checked 2026-11-03). Upstream allows 8.3 to 8.2 or 8.0, but there is no PSMDB 8.2, so the only PSMDB target is 8.0 via MongoDB's 'Downgrade 8.3 to 8.0' procedure with FCV "8.0". Same blocking features as MongoDB 8.3.
8.3.upstream_quote: If you need to downgrade from 8.3, downgrade to the latest patch release of 8.0.
